methods.description: For each complete covered component, count native JRC pixel centers within the unchanged geometry for all twelve months using every intersecting full-resolution block. A phase is the whole component-year and is admitted before pixel reads. Aggregate only authenticated component outputs; no raster pixels are reopened.
methods.units: dated monthly source-grid pixel centers; not area or classification
methods.area_method: No area is estimated; polygon membership is tested at native pixel centers using Shapely contains_xy.

conclusions.text: All 24 source TIFFs have retained whole-file SHA-256 bindings; the prior independent native audit records EPSG:4326 north-up transforms and establishes the two tile footprints.
The corrected 2024 monthly source-grid pixel-center series was reproduced byte-identically twice for 23 footprint-covered components; 47 components have no native tile coverage and remain unknown.
Only families whose every component has full native raster footprint coverage receive family monthly counts; incomplete families remain unknown.

The monthly detections do not establish wet area, physical land/water class, rightful territory, ownership, cause, boundaries, or historical state; administrative and water-source limitations in the prior packet remain unresolved.
